notes.title: On Kickstarter - Latest Reine Works Title!
notes.notes:
[url=http://kck.st/3kwp68q]Reine Works' latest otome game, "I Want to be an Idol!" is now live on Kickstarter! [/url]

[url=http://kck.st/3kwp68q][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/47be37ee793974bc8731e85c5229050c9967a3ed.png[/img][/url]

Itsuki Hayashibara's dream is to become an idol. Her parents' dream for her is to take over the dental practice. With one year to prove to them that she's a capable adult who can make good decisions, she sets out her comedic journey of growth. She might even find some romance along the way...!

"I Want to be an Idol" is a mix of stat-raiser and visual novel that allows you to create your own unique story for Itsuki. Explore Tokyo and forge deep relationships with those around you, or keep working hard towards your dream alone: the choice is in your hands!

We're presently working on getting the game's Steam page live, but in the meantime, make sure to check out our Kickstarter campaign!

Link: http://kck.st/3kwp68q

notes.title: Yuri Cyberpunk Thriller Synergia has been released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It's been a long time coming, but we are proud to announce that Synergia is finally live! After 4 years, the game is finally out. Synergia is a unique cyberpunk yuri thriller, wrapped up in a neon artstyle.

One android's fate may spell the difference between peace, war, the blossoming of a new religion, or a technological singularity beyond comprehension.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1047010/Synergia/

The game features over 100+ unique CGs & BGs, multiple endings, and up to an estimated 10+ hours of gameplay. Also includes steam achievements! The game will run a 10% discount for the week of its release.

notes.title: Kickstarter Live! Signed and Sealed With a Kiss
notes.notes:
[h1]The Signed and Sealed With a Kiss Kickstarter campaign is live! We are raising funds to hire assistant writers to finish the Expansion Pack more quickly![/h1]

Check it out here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1367486473/signed-and-sealed-with-a-kiss-romance-visual-novel?

[h1]About the game[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/933230/Signed_and_Sealed_With_a_Kiss/

You get an unexpected package delivery one day. When you open it, there’s a man inside - but luckily, he comes with instructions! You have your own impressionable boyfriend. It’s your duty to shape him into a proper person… since he’s actually a “doll” with no past exposure to people. 

However, this delivery wasn’t meant for you. Will you fall in love with the person he turns out to be? Will you be able to keep him by your side?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/ebc1bbc52f7a1ed0bc853e4b5b109f6b415ec826.png[/img]

[b]And these are cuties we're raising funds to get out to ASAP...[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/8ecb27b7525c7a466d769601ab0f721bf11bb9b3.png[/img]

[h1]Kickstarter Campaign[/h1]

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1367486473/signed-and-sealed-with-a-kiss-romance-visual-novel?

Firstly, we'd like to state that Kickstarter Backers will [i]not[/i] get any sort of benefit over itch.io or Steam purchasers. There will be no exclusive updates or content, because that would obviously not be fair.

We have lots of different tiers to offer, both with digital & physical goods, as well as physical-only tiers for those who've already bought the game elsewhere. 

If you'd like to support the campaign without pledging, we'd appreciate any & all social media shares you can offer! Thank you very much for your support!

notes.title: Released: Reflections ~Dreams and Reality~
notes.notes:
Our latest release, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1035700/Reflections_Dreams_and_Reality/]Reflections ~Dreams and Reality~[/url], is now available on Steam with a 20% off discount! With a wide variety of love interests, there's bound to someone who suits your tastes!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/8669c7e48ff7b2fc35fe01de428eb8b525f1e915.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/88328b7663c3a01f1f4bbf183c71318981536692.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/0fab1418d3331d924cbeb58429446823d9ca611c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/4fcc1474814090d7dd5791b524aa767bdaff27ce.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/95fce4fdc97a2abce4c3d3db065d53867760c355.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/49cb030dae5b69a437be48bc453133c4de9ffe84.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/151e00c806a9e48c2c606eb827cc06ab377b61c8.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33511056/cf68b4748793cada254e6accbd63e28f5c8d0fe7.png[/img][/url]

SYNOPSIS:
There's another side to each person, one that we cannot see without help. There are those who seek out said help, each earnestly wishing to find their true selves. It is then that they seek out the one known as the "Magic Mirror," a revered sorceress of recent legend.

Watch as the darkness lifts in the hearts of those who seek out the Magic Mirror. Follow Reina and experience nine short and sweet tales of romance, friendship, and unrequited love.

FEATURES:
[list]
[*] Four GxB routes
[*] Four GxG routes
[*] One secret, unlock-able route
[*] 150,000+ words
[*] 19 endings
[*] Original theme song by harmonicblend
[*] 40+ unique CGs
[*] Two interchangeable sprite sets
[*] Partial voice acting with talents from “The Ancient Magus' Bride”, “Yandere Simulator”, and more
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3 - Chinese Translation + Mature Content
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As of 1/29/19, Reine Works has added another patch (1.3) to the game.

Here's the changelog:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese translation added - Switch between English and Chinese on the main menu
    [*] 1 English typo fixed
    [*] A minor bug within Isolde's route was fixed
   [*]  Ending/credits sequence was redone - New ending theme added
    [*] The content patch was updated with various typo fixes
[/list]

We've also added the mature content patch those over the age of 18 courtesy of Reine Works. It's free and can be downloaded from here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1023670/The_Wilting_Amaranth__Mature_Content/
    
----------

The Wilting Amaranth（花朵永不凋零）是一款简短的百合向游戏。故事以民
间传说为蓝本。其中包含2条角色分支，13个结局和3到5小时的游戏流程。

三个女人一台戏。在恶名昭彰的女巫塔内，她们被命运的红绳紧缚着，走尽
百转千层。她们各自有各自的不幸，她们饱含爱意却不可倾诉——展露出真
实的自我，透露出对同性的喜爱，会遭到人们的唾弃。面对如此现状，唯有
苦苦挣扎。

与社会主流的爱情观背道而驰，真的会迎来圆满结局吗？
